description: This source file defines a SwiftUI view component and related views for a talk overlay interface in a macOS application. It includes visual elements like interactive orbital rings, a close button, and animated wave rings that respond to different speaking/listening states.

classes.name: OrbInteractionNSView
classes.description: A custom NSView subclass handling mouse interactions for click, double click, and drag events within the overlay.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and initializes an OrbInteractionNSView, setting callback closures.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the existing NSView with new callback closures.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events, distinguishes between clicks and drags, and triggers corresponding callbacks.

methods.name: mouseDragged
methods.description: Handles dragging events, initiates window dragging if movement exceeds threshold.

methods.name: mouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up events, triggers single click if no drag occurred.
